The photo  shoot was a birthday present for my wige and she loved it.
  Mercedes, the owner was just terrific, helping with the dress and makeup and just adding to the fun of the experience.  more than 100 photos were taken.
  I would highly recommend this experience for  anyone.

title: Beautiful location and experience
text: The train ride from Barcelona was interesting and the location Sitges was beautiful. The dresses were of a large variety to choose from and  i was assisted with my hairdo to look like a real Flamenco dancer
author: Sandra_B

title: A Fun and Unforgettable Experience
text: I was in Stiges celebrating a friends birthday. While looking for things to do in Stiges on TripAdvisor I came across this Dress up like a Flamenca dancer experience. It was such a fun and unique way to celebrate my friend. We all had such a fun time while the owner Mercedes dressed us up like a flamenco! 💃 She has a cute shop filled with beautiful clothes and jewelry made by local artists to look at and buy. And Mercedes could not have been nicer as she helped us bring out the power of the flamenca woman within us! We took lots of pictures out in her adorable patio. An experience we will neve
author: X8033NByvonnes

title: Flamenco Dress Up
text: We came and did the flamenco dress up class with 9 girls. She gave an introduction and then started dressing us. She did up everyone real quick. You didn't get to choose your dress. She had one already picked. I guess she looks at you and bases on your size and height. She did our hair and makeup quick too. She took different photos of us and then we looked through what she had for sale. Overall a fun experience. Definitely include the dancing.
author: marield1990
